motivation: v0.66 retained a negative exact sigma8 tangent response at every primary redshift and every tested tangent amplification, but failed three preregistered consistency gates. Two failures were approximately 20 percent and coincided with the k-kernel peaking at the upper boundary kh=1.999 h/Mpc, suggesting unresolved high-k support. A third failure was lambda dependence of the sigma8-squared estimator. v0.67 is a result-informed numerical/theory follow-up. It does not alter the v0.66 FAIL. It extends only the numerical k support and directly audits tangent affinity on the extended power-spectrum response before any further physical interpretation.

source_results.known_v066_sign_result: R_exact(lambda,z)<0 for all four tested lambda values and all seven primary redshifts z=0.2...0.8.
source_results.known_v066_boundary_fact: For every primary redshift the largest absolute mean kernel density occurred at the upper sampled boundary kh=1.999 h/Mpc; the 0.5...1.999 h/Mpc bin supplied most of the absolute kernel weight.
source_results.policy: v0.67 is a new post-v0.66 follow-up and must not be described as retroactively converting v0.66 into a PASS.

frozen_physical_model.memory_forcing_construction: unchanged v0.39/v0.63 positive-Drude construction with control order 512 and primary order 1024; the accepted source-grid trace is extended only in k coverage so that the k-dependent forcing file covers the diagnostic range

numerical_k_extension.reason: The v0.66 kernel peaked at its numerical upper boundary. The k extension is therefore a result-informed numerical-domain diagnostic, not a new physical parameter choice.

estimators.baseline_sigma8_squared_integrand: I0(k,z)=k^3 P0(k,z) W_TH^2(k R8)/(2 pi^2), integrated in d ln k.
estimators.power_tangent: g_lambda(k,z)=[P(+lambda)-P(-lambda)]/[2 lambda P0]=d ln Pm/d eta in an affine transfer family.
estimators.weighted_affinity_metric: For each primary z and lambda, epsilon_aff=sqrt[int I0 (g_lambda-gbar)^2 dlnk / int I0 gbar^2 dlnk], with gbar the arithmetic mean over the four preregistered lambda values. The reported gate is the maximum epsilon_aff over primary z and lambda.
estimators.tail_fraction: For each z, f_8_16=int_8^16 I0 dlnk / int_kmin^16 I0 dlnk. This is a direct measure of unresolved sigma8 support in the final preregistered shell.

secondary_reports_no_gate: nested baseline sigma8-squared reconstruction at nominal caps 2, 4, 8, and 16 h/Mpc
signed and absolute kernel contribution in every fixed k bin
R_exact and g_lambda at context redshifts 1.0, 1.2, and 1.5
location of the largest absolute mean kernel density at each redshift
per-lambda weighted affinity metric at each redshift
the 8...16 h/Mpc baseline sigma8 support fraction at each redshift

classification_policy.meaning: PASS certifies, within the preregistered k range, that the sigma8 integral is numerically closed, the last high-k shell is negligible, the externally forced tangent response is lambda-affine in the sigma8-weighted sense, the k-kernel reproduces the direct sigma8-squared tangent estimator, and the primary growth derivative remains negative. It is not an observational detection and does not change v0.65 or v0.66 historical classifications.

anti_tuning: After this predata file is committed, do not change the frozen cosmology, KB, tauH0, p, CLASS commit, Drude forcing orders, lambda set, redshift sets, numerical k extension, nested caps, fixed bins, estimators, weighting, or numerical gates after reading v0.67 results. A FAIL is retained.
